+"""Standalone helper to prepend a Mark to an object's ``pytestmark``.
+
+Behaves like pytest's mark storing helper but places the new mark before
+the existing direct marks. All pytest-specific collaborators are
+injected so this module stays importable without pytest fixtures or marks.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def prepend_mark(
+    Mark: type,
+    getfixturemarker: Callable[[object], object | None],
+    get_unpacked_marks: Callable[..., list[Any]],
+    warn: Callable[..., object],
+    warning_message: object,
+    obj: Any,
+    mark: Any,
+    *,
+    stacklevel: int = 2,
+) -> None:
+    """Prepend a Mark on an object.
+
+    This is used to implement the Mark declarations/decorators correctly.
+    """
+    assert isinstance(mark, Mark), mark
+
+    if getfixturemarker(obj) is not None:
+        warn(warning_message, stacklevel=stacklevel)
+
+    # Always reassign name to avoid updating pytestmark in a reference that
+    # was only borrowed.
+    obj.pytestmark = [mark, *get_unpacked_marks(obj, consider_mro=False)]
diff --git a/testing/test_standalone_prepend_mark.py b/testing/test_standalone_prepend_mark.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..31e91f0cb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_standalone_prepend_mark.py
@@ -0,0 +1,204 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+import warnings
+
+from _pytest.deprecated import MARKED_FIXTURE
+from _pytest.fixtures import getfixturemarker
+from _pytest.mark.structures import get_unpacked_marks
+from _pytest.mark.structures import Mark
+from _pytest.mark.structures import store_mark
+import pytest
+
+
+_MODULE_PATH = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_prepend_mark.py"
+
+
+def _load_module() -> Any:
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_prepend_mark", _MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+prepend_mark = _load_module().prepend_mark
+MESSAGE = MARKED_FIXTURE
+
+
+def _prepend(obj: object, mark: object, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
+    prepend_mark(
+        Mark,
+        getfixturemarker,
+        get_unpacked_marks,
+        warnings.warn,
+        MESSAGE,
+        obj,
+        mark,
+        **kwargs,
+    )
+
+
+def _mark(name: str) -> Mark:
+    return Mark(name, (), {}, _ispytest=True)
+
+
+def test_module_does_not_depend_on_pytest() -> None:
+    source = _MODULE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "_pytest" not in source
+    assert "store_mark" not in source
+    assert "import pytest" not in source
+
+
+def test_empty_object_gets_single_mark() -> None:
+    def f() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    a = _mark("a")
+    _prepend(f, a)
+    assert f.pytestmark == [a]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+
+
+def test_prepends_before_existing_marks() -> None:
+    def f() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    a, b, c = _mark("a"), _mark("b"), _mark("c")
+    _prepend(f, a)
+    _prepend(f, b)
+    _prepend(f, c)
+    assert f.pytestmark == [c, b, a]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+
+
+def test_order_is_reverse_of_store_mark() -> None:
+    def f() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    def g() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    marks = [_mark("a"), _mark("b"), _mark("c")]
+    for m in marks:
+        store_mark(f, m)
+        _prepend(g, m)
+    assert g.pytestmark == list(reversed(f.pytestmark))  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+
+
+def test_non_list_pytestmark_is_unpacked() -> None:
+    def f() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    a, b = _mark("a"), _mark("b")
+    f.pytestmark = a  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    _prepend(f, b)
+    assert f.pytestmark == [b, a]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+
+
+def test_reassigns_fresh_list() -> None:
+    a, b = _mark("a"), _mark("b")
+    borrowed = [a]
+
+    class Base:
+        pytestmark = borrowed
+
+    _prepend(Base, b)
+    assert Base.pytestmark == [b, a]
+    assert borrowed == [a]
+    assert Base.pytestmark is not borrowed
+
+
+def test_class_uses_direct_marks_only() -> None:
+    a, b = _mark("a"), _mark("b")
+
+    class Base:
+        pytestmark = [a]
+
+    class Child(Base):
+        pass
+
+    _prepend(Child, b)
+    assert Child.pytestmark == [b]
+    assert Base.pytestmark == [a]
+
+
+def test_rejects_non_mark() -> None:
+    def f() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
+        _prepend(f, "not a mark")
+    assert not hasattr(f, "pytestmark")
+
+
+def test_warns_on_fixture_with_stacklevel() -> None:
+    calls: list[tuple[object, int]] = []
+
+    def warn(message: object, *, stacklevel: int) -> None:
+        calls.append((message, stacklevel))
+
+    @pytest.fixture
+    def fix() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    a = _mark("a")
+    prepend_mark(
+        Mark,
+        getfixturemarker,
+        get_unpacked_marks,
+        warn,
+        MESSAGE,
+        fix,
+        a,
+        stacklevel=5,
+    )
+    assert calls == [(MESSAGE, 5)]
+    assert fix.pytestmark == [a]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+
+
+def test_no_warning_for_plain_function() -> None:
+    calls: list[object] = []
+
+    def f() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    prepend_mark(
+        Mark,
+        getfixturemarker,
+        get_unpacked_marks,
+        lambda *a, **k: calls.append(a),
+        MESSAGE,
+        f,
+        _mark("a"),
+    )
+    assert calls == []
+
+
+def test_default_stacklevel_is_two() -> None:
+    calls: list[int] = []
+
+    def warn(message: object, *, stacklevel: int) -> None:
+        calls.append(stacklevel)
+
+    prepend_mark(
+        Mark,
+        lambda obj: object(),
+        get_unpacked_marks,
+        warn,
+        MESSAGE,
+        lambda: None,
+        _mark("a"),
+    )
+    assert calls == [2]
+
+
+def test_real_warning_emitted_for_fixture() -> None:
+    @pytest.fixture
+    def fix() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    with pytest.warns(type(MARKED_FIXTURE)):
+        _prepend(fix, _mark("a"))
